info.title: API.SH: Coursera
info.description: The Coursera API from API.SH: public Coursera data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Without `slug`: Coursera's topic tree (each category with its description, link and subcategories). With `slug`: that category's catalogue with every search filter (level, type, duration, language, partner, skills, cost, sort): total, results (name, type, partners, rating and count, level, duration, skills, free and credit flags, image) and facets with counts, plus the category and its subcategories. A subcategory searches its name within its category. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coursera-category

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Category slug (data-science), category/subcategory (data-science/machine-learning) or a coursera.org/browse link. Leave out for the topic tree.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to search within the category.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Product type, e.g. Courses, Specializations, Professional Certificates, Guided Projects, Degrees.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: e.g. Less Than 2 Hours, 1-4 Weeks, 1-3 Months, 3-6 Months.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: University or company name, e.g. Google.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Without `slug`: every online degree on Coursera with name, type, partners, categories, language, tuition in USD, credits, number of courses, bachelor's requirement, application fee, scholarships, pay-as-you-go, QS ranking, cohorts per year, next admission start, application deadline and term start, plus the degree categories. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coursera-degree

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
